name: ASM-004 linear rail carriage assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a small linear guide, moving carriage, side rollers, end stops, and clamp plate.

tasks.prompt: Create a small linear rail carriage assembly with a base guide rail, moving carriage, side rollers or bearings, end stops, and a clamp plate. Use meaningful repeated roller and end stop components without fragile details.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark intended to exercise hierarchy, named modules, and repeated functional components without BRIEF-001 full-vehicle complexity.
Robust simple boxes, cylinders, and compounds are preferred over fragile booleans or detailed decorative hardware.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
